title: Wordplay and humour
summary: Get the joke: homonyms such as *yüz*, *gül* and *yaz* behind Turkish puns, the cinas of folk verse and the sounds of tongue twisters, the fıkra with its setup, turn and punchline, and the irony, understatement and teasing of everyday conversation.
canDo: Hear both meanings of a homonym and make a simple pun
Say what the cinas of a mani does and read a tongue twister aloud
Follow and retell a fıkra, keeping its tense and its punchline
Recognize irony and understatement, and tease without giving offence
